text:
jen: noticing a steady drop in GPU allocator success rate since the subnet policy roll earlier this morning. failures are at ~18% for new nodes.
sanjay: confirmed -- new nodes in eu-west1 failing to attach to keystore for decrypt (KMS). logs show 403s from keystore-audit-service.
maria: is this the policy that tightened allowed egress to audit collectors?
jen: yes, tightened to deny anything outside privatelink endpoints. looks like the keystore proxy traffic was on an exception list that didn't get applied to the gpu-subnet.
kevin: quick datapoint: fallback routing to region-bucket is working but causes 300-400ms extra boot latency per node. that means longer warmup and more failed autoscale attempts -> cost spike.
sanjay: stack trace snippet from the kubelet logs: ```2025-06-02T09:12:01Z keystore-proxy: POST /decrypt 403 {"reason":"audit-ns:out-of-scope"}```
maria: ugh. audit retention policy PR merged at 02:20. looks like subnet tag propagation missed two zones. ticket #INF-7234 created.
jen: ops-bot alerted at 09:25 but it was noisy, we missed. can we patch a temporary allowlist for keystore endpoints for gpu-subnet?
kevin: we can, but NAT egress goes through per-region NATGW and adding allowlist will increase traffic through private-link endpoint and bump our egress bill. estimate +$1200/day if sustained.
sanjay: alternative is to rollback the subnet policy only for the tagged gpu-subnet and redeploy. rollback should be low-risk if we limit to eu-west1-a/b.
maria: propose small blast radius: rollback in eu-west1-a first, monitor 15m, then b. set canary weight 10%.
jen: agree. add playbook steps: 1) patch subnet tag 2) remove deny-everywhere rule 3) restart node-controller in region 4) watch allocator metrics.
kevin: I'll prepare a CLI snippet for rollback: ```gcloud compute networks subnets update gpu-subnet-eu --remove-private-ip-google-access --region eu-west1``` (this is a placeholder, will use infra console).
maria: also add temporary k8s affinity to prefer already-warmed nodes to reduce new allocations while we triage. quick helm patch: ```kubectl patch deployment allocator -n infra -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"affinity":{"podAntiAffinity":null}}}}}'```
jen: doing the rollback now for eu-west1-a. will post when done. :thumbsup:
(2m later) deploy-bot: rollback applied to eu-west1-a by jen at 09:42 UTC.
jen: eu-west1-a showing allocator success up from 81% -> 98% within 6 minutes. joining rate stabilized.
kevin: good. watch NATGW cost and keystore audit queue backlog. we may need to schedule proper tag-propagation fix and a postmortem.
sanjay: I've opened INF-7234 and assigned to neteng + keystore. action items: full tag-propagation rollout, add a CI check to ensure subnet tags for keystore exceptions, and run a small chaos test next week.
maria: thanks everyone. I'll draft a short status update for product & infra slack channels, and include cost delta and mitigation notes.
jen: closing thread after postmortem notes added. :white_check_mark:
